label: Bible Study
prompt: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and _____ one another, even as also ye do.
verse: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
note: Comfort and build each other up — Paul notes the Thessalonians were already doing it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by _____.
verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
note: Moses asks for God's presence; God answers: thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen _____.
verse: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
note: The oxen stumbled and Uzza reached out to steady the ark — a lesson that God's holy things are carried his way.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a _____ plucked out of the fire?
verse: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
note: The high priest Joshua, accused by Satan, is defended by God as a burning stick snatched from the fire.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great _____, and sin against God?
verse: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
note: Joseph to Potiphar's wife: not 'I might get caught' but 'how can I sin against God?' — integrity in one question.
